newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank supports lev near 234 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank supports lev near 234 per dollar.

text.p: Bulgaria's central bank (BNB) supported the lev on the interbank forex market, stabilising it in a 233.50-234.50 per dollar range around 1015 local time (0715 GMT), up from 234-235 at the opening, a BNB official said.
"We sell small (dollar volumes) at market rates to limit the lev's fall within the usual Thursday limits," the official who declined to be named told Reuters.

The lev eased to 234-235 in early trade from 232.00/20 at the close on Wednesday because of the longer period to value date of Thursday's spot deals and a rise in foreign currency demand from final clients, dealers said.

"At the very opening the dollar was bid at 234 levs and asked at 235 levs, but shortly after that the central bank launched dollar sales and boosted the lev to 233.50/234.50 per dollar," one dealer said.
Commercial bank dealers said the central bank was selling dollars at 233.00/30 per dollar to a number of banks.
Today's spot deals are to be settled on Monday, allowing dollar buyers to profit on high yield lev deposits during the weekend.

The current spread between interest rates on lev-denominated and dollar-denominated investments allows the national currency to ease by around 0.7 levs to the dollar daily, traders said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
